SL: Cumulative amount shipped through this date.
NF: The product requested is not publicly available at this time.
SP: Product is anticipated for manufacture on this date.
IC: The material previously ordered is no longer needed.
SS: Shipment is only part of the ordered quantity.
NN: The product requested is neither available nor in process, as there is not an authorization to manufacture product.
NS: The product requested is neither available nor in process. A planned dispatch date has been provided.
IS: The quantity and product shipped is compliant with the expectation.
PK: Quantity represents the amount processed and ready for shipment at this date.
ZZZ: A code assigned within a code list to be used on an interim basis and as defined among trading partners until a precise code can be assigned to the code list.
LS: The date that the most recent material dispatch was made.
BK: An order is being held as no material is available to fulfil the requirement.
BP: A portion of the previous order is being held as open, as enough material was not available to fulfil the requirement.
TW: Product is, for the time being, not available from the distribution point.
OF: The product requested is not available. The schedule has been forwarded to manufacturing for inclusion on this date.
OM: The product has been moved to the manufacturing area and scheduled for completion on the following date.
OS: Item is not available due to strike or an unforeseeable event.
OW: Item is not available at the distribution point.
RA: Product is restricted because of limited availability.
CA: The response includes information concerning all of the issues included in the prior inquiry.
CC: The quantity dispatched fulfilled the order quantity.
CE: The quantity dispatched exceeds the order quantity to accommodate a quantity of scale price model opportunity.
CI: The response includes information addressing only of the items dispatched that were included in the prior inquiry.
CK: Amount deleted from the earlier schedule.
CM: The quantity dispatched exceeds the ordered quantity.
CO: The response includes information addressing only the items that have not been dispatched, that were included in the prior inquiry.
CP: The quantity shipped is less than the amount authorized and there is no plan to ship the remaining amount.
CS: The quantity and product shipped, though not exactly matching the original order, is compliant with and fulfils the expectation.
PA: The response includes information concerning all of the articles included in the prior inquiry that had been requested by the contact initiator.
PD: The amount fulfilling the requirements of the contract.
PI: The response includes information concerning all of the articles that were dispatched and included in the prior inquiry that had been requested by the contact initiator.
UR: The product information was provided voluntarily.
US: Pack to the closest complete logistic packaging quantity.
UT: Pack to the next lower complete logistic packaging quantity.
PN: This amount is being manufactured in anticipation for a possible authorization for shipment.
PO: The response includes information concerning all of the articles that were not dispatched and included in the prior inquiry that had been requested by the contact initiator.
PP: The response includes information concerning a unique sub-set of the total list of articles that the contract initiator had requested information on.
PS: This amount is being manufactured in anticipation for a possible authorization for shipment.
AA: The wholesaler no longer offers the ordered product.
AB: The item ordered has been discontinued and is no longer in production.
AC: Code indicating that there was an excess quantity of goods in a shipment relative to the order.
AD: The item is out of stock at manufacturer.
AE: Shipment or goods have been delivered without any advance notification of delivery.
AF: Part or all of the goods in a shipment were delivered damaged.
AG: Delivered but at a later date than the delivery date under the agreed conditions or stipulated in the order.
AH: The ordered item has been, or is to be, packed to the next higher packaging quantity.
AN: The material is available for shipment but there is no authorization for movement known.
AS: The material is available for shipment and is committed for shipment/delivery at a future date.
